title: List reusable browser sessions
description: List the browser sessions a task can open pages in, each with the websites it holds sign-in evidence for: the person's default session, the named sessions (sessionGroup new/previous) and the managed application accounts' own sessions (dsagent.page.open accountId).
guidance: Call it before opening a site for a task that names an application account, or whose site needs a sign-in: prefer a session whose site state is signed-in and whose accountLabel, observedAccountLabel or account names match the account the task names, and open the page there (default: omit sessionGroup; named: sessionGroup previous with sessionName; account: accountId). accountLabel is the account the person said they signed in with on DSphere's sign-in sheet; signed-in means the person passed a sign-in wall there and no wall was found since, which is evidence, not proof: a page that shows a wall again is handed to the person as usual. Never start a new session or ask the person to sign in again when a matching signed-in session is listed. previousAccountLabel with accountSwitchedAt means the person later signed in there with another account: when the task needs the previous account, do not use that session for it; tell the person. Read-only; no page is opened.

site.description: Optional website (an http(s) address or a host such as www.example.com): only that site's evidence, and only sessions holding some (the default session is always listed).

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text matched against session names, application and account names, the account labels the person gave and the accounts pages showed.

outputSchema.description: The reusable browser sessions, the default first, then the most recently signed in.

sessions.description: Browser sessions with their sign-in evidence.

session.description: The browser session the page is in: default (the person's own), named (sessionGroup new/previous; reopen with previous and sessionName), account (a managed application account's own session; open pages in it with dsagent.page.open accountId) or other (a session agents cannot open pages in, such as a workflow run's isolated one).

sessionName.description: With named: the session's name, for sessionGroup previous.

accountId.description: With account: the opaque application account id, for dsagent.page.open accountId.

accountName.description: With account: the account's label in the person's account catalog.

openPages.description: How many tabs of the session are open now.

sites.description: Websites the session holds sign-in evidence for, most recent first.

items.description: The sign-in evidence of one website in the session.

site.description: The website's registrable domain (sign-ins span its hosts), for example example.com.

state.description: signed-in: the person passed a sign-in wall here and none was found since; sign-in-required: the last word is a sign-in wall.

accountLabel.description: The account the person said they signed in with, when they gave one.

signedInAt.description: When the person last passed a sign-in wall here (ISO 8601).

wallAt.description: When a sign-in wall was last found here (ISO 8601).

previousAccountLabel.description: The account named here before, when the person later signed in with another one: the session switched accounts on this site. In the default session that also switched the person's own browsing.

accountSwitchedAt.description: When the session switched from previousAccountLabel to the account it uses now here (ISO 8601).

switchEvidence.description: What told the switch: named (the person named another account on the sign-in sheet; compare accountLabel) or observed (the page showed another signed-in account; compare observedAccountLabel).

observedAccountLabel.description: The account the page last showed as signed in on this site in this session (dsagent.page.account.detect, or read after a sign-in): what the page shows, evidence rather than proof.

observedAt.description: When the page last showed observedAccountLabel (ISO 8601).
